annotations.title: Explain This Prop — why a player prop is a call

description: Why PredictionMarketsPicks publishes a call on one NFL player prop this week: the Kalshi contract, the YES/NO call and Kalshi's price for that side, our tier and — where our probability is measured calibrated — our odds, our projection against the threshold, whether it is published or held at WATCH (and why), The Ladder's read on that stat, and what the model does not account for. One contract per call. Use for "why do you like <player>'s over", "explain the <player> prop", "why is <player> on your board". For the full strike ladder use explain_player.

line.description: Optional contract threshold or line (e.g. 60 or 59.5) to pick one strike.

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Josh Allen").

stat.description: Optional stat, e.g. "rec_yds", "receptions", "rush_yds", "pass_tds" or "receiving yards". Defaults to the player's strongest published call.
